site.pricingPage.metaDescription: Simple per-month pricing for property managers. Every plan includes tenant portals, maintenance tracking and role-based access.
site.pricingPage.title: Pricing that scales with your portfolio
site.pricingPage.lead: Start free, upgrade when your portfolio grows. No setup fees, no per-tenant charges, cancel any time.
site.pricingPage.footnote: All plans include role-based access control, the tenant portal, and multi-currency support. Prices are in {currency} and exclude any tax that applies in your country.
site.pricingPage.faq.changePlans.answer: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time from Settings → Billing. Changes are prorated by your card issuer's billing cycle, and your data is never touched by a plan change.
site.pricingPage.faq.trialEnds.question: What happens when my trial ends?
site.pricingPage.faq.trialEnds.answer: Nothing is deleted. Your account moves to the Free plan and keeps working within its limits — pick a paid plan whenever you're ready to restore the rest.
site.pricingPage.faq.tenantSeats.questio: Do tenants need a paid seat?
site.pricingPage.faq.tenantSeats.answer: No. Tenant accounts are free and unlimited on every plan. Seat limits apply only to your staff — admins and managers.
site.pricingPage.faq.paymentFails.answer: We email you and keep your paid features available during a short grace period so a bounced card never locks you out mid-month.
site.pricingPage.talkToUsAfter: — we'll walk you through the plan that fits your portfolio.

site.contactPage.lead: Pick the topic that fits and we'll route your message to the right person. We reply on business days.
site.contactPage.accountBody: Most questions are quicker to answer from inside the app, where we can see your organization's setup. Sign in and use the feedback option in the dashboard, or head straight to
